title: Comment
description: A comment on a file. Some resource methods (such as `comments.update`) require a `commentId`. Use the `comments.list` method to retrieve the ID for a comment in a file.

content.description: The plain text content of the comment. This field is used for setting the content, while `htmlContent` should be displayed.

mentionedEmailAddresses.description: Output only. A list of email addresses for users mentioned in this comment. If no users are mentioned, the list is empty.

modifiedTime.description: The last time the comment or any of its replies was modified (RFC 3339 date-time).

kind.description: Output only. Identifies what kind of resource this is. Value: the fixed string `"drive#comment"`.

htmlContent.description: Output only. The content of the comment with HTML formatting.

quotedFileContent.description: The file content to which the comment refers, typically within the anchor region. For a text file, for example, this would be the text at the location of the comment.

value.description: The quoted content itself. This is interpreted as plain text if set through the API.

mimeType.description: The MIME type of the quoted content.

deleted.description: Output only. Whether the comment has been deleted. A deleted comment has no content.

id.description: Output only. The ID of the comment.

createdTime.description: The time at which the comment was created (RFC 3339 date-time).

assigneeEmailAddress.description: Output only. The email address of the user assigned to this comment. If no user is assigned, the field is unset.

resolved.description: Output only. Whether the comment has been resolved by one of its replies.

anchor.description: A region of the document represented as a JSON string. For details on defining anchor properties, refer to [Manage comments and replies](https://developers.google.com/workspace/drive/api/v3/manage-comments).

replies.description: Output only. The full list of replies to the comment in chronological order.
